results.title: inKind Secures $414 Million in Financing Led by Citi and Cross River, Surpassing $1.2 Billion in Total Capital Raised
results.content:
AUSTIN, Texas, Aug. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- inKind, the curated restaurant commerce platform helping great restaurants access capital, guests, and technology, today announced the closing of an oversubscribed $414 million second financing tranche led by Citi and Cross River alongside Sagard, Varadero Capital, and Trinity Capital. The transaction brings inKind's total capital raised to more than $1.2 billion. [...] Today, inKind partners with nationally recognized groups such as MINA Group, Ethan Stowell Restaurants, and José Andrés Group, as well as acclaimed independent operators including Okàn, Kann, and Superiority Burger. The company has provided more than $850 million in growth capital to restaurant partners and delivered more than $225 million in dining rewards to guests.

Institutional Capital Behind a Scalable Restaurant Platform

The new tranche significantly expands the group of institutional investors supporting inKind's growth.

Together with Liberty Mutual Investments debt investment, the new financing provides inKind with additional long-term capacity to support restaurant operators nationwide and further validate the company's model as an emerging institutional asset class. [...] The closing followsLiberty Mutual Investments' recently announced $320 million commitment as a senior anchor and mezzanine lender. With the expanded facility, inKind plans to deploy more than $1 billion in growth capital to nearly 10,000 restaurants over the next year.

The transaction marks a major milestone for inKind and the restaurant industry, bringing institutional scale to a model designed to help high-quality restaurants access growth capital while creating incremental guest demand. It also expands the capital foundation behind a commerce platform that becomes more valuable as more restaurants and diners join and its proprietary data advantage deepens.

# inKind Secures $414 Million Financing, Bringing Total Capital Raised Above $1.2 Billion

By Amit Chowdhry

Pulse 2.0

inKind Secures $414 Million Financing, Bringing Total Capital Raised Above $1.2 Billion

Follow Pulse 2.0 on LinkedIn

inKind has closed an oversubscribed $414 million second financing tranche led by Citi and Cross River, bringing the restaurant commerce platform’s total capital raised to more than $1.2 billion.

The financing includes $175 million from Citi and $150 million from Cross River at the senior level, along with $50 million from Sagard, $25 million from Varadero Capital and $14 million from Trinity Capital in mezzanine financing. [...] The closing follows a recently announced $320 million commitment from Liberty Mutual Investments as a senior anchor and mezzanine lender. With the expanded facility, inKind plans to deploy more than $1 billion in growth capital to nearly 10,000 restaurants over the next year.

Citi’s participation also expands an existing relationship with inKind, following a 2025 investment by Citi Ventures.

inKind operates a restaurant commerce platform that combines upfront capital, demand generation, financial tools, guest rewards, proprietary data and AI-native capabilities. Its network currently connects more than 5 million diners with more than 8,500 restaurants representing nearly $30 billion in annual restaurant gross merchandise value. [...] The company has expanded from approximately 1,000 restaurant partners in 2022 to more than 8,500 today. Its user base has also increased from roughly 1 million in March 2024 to more than 5 million.

inKind has provided more than $850 million in growth capital to restaurant partners and delivered more than $225 million in dining rewards to guests. Its restaurant partners include MINA Group, Ethan Stowell Restaurants, José Andrés Group, Okàn, Kann and Superiority Burger.

KEY QUOTES:

“For more than a decade, inKind has been building a new way to finance and grow great restaurants.”
